{{Top|leg}}
A '''gemmaster''' was a [[Balinaka]] [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] who worked in the production of [[Garnib crystal]]s. They would polish and smooth the various gems and glass pieces intended for the sculpture, and carve intricate designs into them.
